This Appeal, Coming On For Final Hearing, This Day,
The Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment

An appeal has been filed by the claimants under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988,
challenging the award dated 06.01.2018 in MVC No. 2695/2016 passed by the XXI Additional Small Causes Judge and the MACT (SCCH-23), Bengaluru.

2. Appellant/claimant No.1 is the niece of the deceased M. Bhaskar, and appellant/claimant No.2 is the elder brother of the deceased who died in a road traffic accident on 13.04.2015 due to the rash and negligent driving by the driver of the tractor-trailer.
The Tribunal awarded total compensation of Rs. 2,16,000/- with interest at 6% per annum.
The claimants are before this Court seeking enhancement of compensation.
3. The learned counsel for the appellants/claimants and the learned counsel for the respondent-Insurance Company were heard, and the records were perused.
4. The learned counsel for the respondent-Insurance Company vehemently contended that the claimants were not NC: 2024:KHC:22252 dependent on the income of the deceased.
Therefore, the Tribunal's award of Rs. 2,16,600/- as just and proper compensation is justified.
5. During the examination-in-chief, claimant No.2 was examined as PW.1, and he categorically stated that the deceased used to contribute his entire income to his family.
In his cross- examination, he firmly denied the suggestions made by the Insurance Company that the deceased did not contribute his entire income to the family.
To substantiate that the deceased was residing with the claimants, they produced a ration card indicating that the deceased lived with them.
